LanguageData.MSSG_StrikeWonText: The noblins have their shinies. They are back to work, very pleased with themselves.
LanguageData.MSSG_StrikeBrokenMessage: Nobody paid the striking noblins. They have gone back to work in a sulk.
LanguageData.MSSG_RummageDesc: Order a colonist (not a noblin) to spend two hours digging the noblins' hidden loot out of the pit and dropping it beside it. Uses the Hauling work type.
LanguageData.MSSG_ChallengeNoChampion: No goblin who can fight is available.

LanguageData.MSSG_ChallengeDuelStarts: {0} and {1} square up for the duel!
LanguageData.MSSG_ChallengeRefused: The hobgoblin challenge was refused. The challenger sneers and leaves. Your goblins are ashamed.
LanguageData.MSSG_ChallengeTimedOut: Nobody answered the hobgoblin's challenge. It sneers and leaves. Your goblins are ashamed.
LanguageData.MSSG_ChallengeDraw: The duel fizzled out with nobody down. The challenger grunts and leaves.
LanguageData.MSSG_ChallengeLost: {0} lost the duel. The challenger leaves laughing.
LanguageData.MSSG_ChallengeWonText:
{0} has beaten {1} in the duel and earned the respect of {2} kills.
The beaten hobgoblin offers to join the colony.
LanguageData.MSSG_DeathDuelCannotStart: The duel cannot start: one of them cannot fight right now.
LanguageData.MSSG_DeathDuelStarts: {0} and {1} square up for a duel to the death!
LanguageData.MSSG_DeathDuelRefused: {0} and {1} were forbidden their duel. They are sulking.
LanguageData.MSSG_DeathDuelTimedOut: Nobody answered {0} and {1}. They take it as a refusal, and they are sulking.
LanguageData.MSSG_DeathDuelDraw: The duel to the death is over, and nobody walked away with the other's kills.
LanguageData.MSSG_DeathDuelWonText: {0} has killed {1} and taken their kills: {2}.

LanguageData.MSSG_EvolveCapReached: There is already a {0} of this faction here.
LanguageData.MSSG_EvolutionBlockedTip: Cannot evolve: a {0} of this faction is already on this map. Only one is allowed.
LanguageData.MSSG_EvolutionSurgeTip: Further kills can turn them into a Queenie at once, or blow them up. The evolve button is the safe choice.

LanguageData.MSSG_HarvestPartGizmoDesc: Pick a bit to hack off this noblin. Someone'll come over and do it proper: no medsy stuff, no sleepy stuff, just a good chop. Only works about one go in four, mind.
LanguageData.MSSG_PartBadlyAttached: {PAWN_nameDef}'s new {1} went on all wonky. It only half works.
LanguageData.MSSG_QueenInside: {PAWN_nameDef} is curled up down the bottom, snorin'.
LanguageData.MSSG_QueenUnknown: Sumfin' big is snorin' down the bottom.
LanguageData.MSSG_QueenReleased: {PAWN_nameDef} has crawled out of the pit, dead to the world. She'll need a good long kip.
LanguageData.MSSG_RumbleNotEnough: Needs at least {0} noblins able to fight. Only got {1}. Not much of a rumble.
LanguageData.MSSG_RumbleFizzled: The rumble fizzled out: only {0} noblins turned up to scrap, and it needs {1}.
LanguageData.MSSG_RumbleStartText:
{0} noblins have stopped what they were doing and turned on each other. Every nobbo for itself!

They hit harder and faster than usual, and they will finish off anyone who goes down. A noblin with enough kills grows up and walks away a winner.

The last noblin left gets no prize. It must have been hiding.
LanguageData.MSSG_RumbleWinner: {PAWN_nameDef} has bashed enough nobbos to grow up, and staggers out of the rumble a winner!
LanguageData.MSSG_RumblePunished: {PAWN_nameDef} was the last one left. Funny that, nobody remembers seeing {PAWN_objective} throw a punch. Hiding behind a barrel the whole time, the others reckon, except the others are dead. {PAWN_nameDef} has been made a Snoblin for {PAWN_possessive} cowardice.
LanguageData.MSSG_RumblePunishedMany: Only the cowards are left: {0}. Not one of them threw a punch the whole time. They have all been made Snoblins for it.
LanguageData.MSSG_RumbleEnd_Wiped: Nobody left standing. Proper rumble, that.
LanguageData.MSSG_RumbleEnd_AllDown: Everyone left is lying in the dirt. Nobody can be bothered to finish anyone off.
LanguageData.MSSG_RumbleEnd_TimedOut: The nobbos got bored and wandered off. Whoever is left lives to scrap another day.
